subject: redrawing all widgets after an action button push?

messages.author: d6f0b6be0b4f04e7
messages.subject: redrawing all widgets after an action button push?
parts:
I'm new to R shiny, and can't figure out how to have my action button redraw everything in my application after I get it to do a database update. I've attached a simplified version which shows some fields in a table via renderTable and a label field that I want the user to be able to edit in a textarea via renderUI.

Once the user updates the label in the textarea, an actionButton is hit to put the update in a new table.

This all works well, but I'd like to be able to get the actionButton to pull in the next piece of data once the current one has been inserted into the new table, and all of my attempts thus far to do this have failed. Currently I have to refresh the URL to have the next data shown.

I have included a file which sets up a simple pair of tables which can be used as input, and my server.R and ui.R files. Any suggestions or help is much appreciated.

Cheers,
Celia McInnis
